expectedConventions.keys: JSONPath-like keys ($.objetos[0].tribCalc.IBSCBS.gIBSCBS.vBC); 'httpStatus' = HTTP status; '$.x.length()' = array size; '[*]' = applies to every element; '$' = whole body; '$raw' = raw response text; unit vectors: 'throws', 'doesNotThrow', 'result', 'calls[i].result|throws|doesNotThrow', or named aggregates explained in notes; batch (corpus) vectors: 'httpStatus[*]' / 'invariantes[*]' apply to every corpus note.
expectedConventions.values: all expected values are strings (or an array of matcher strings meaning allOf). A plain string = exact text equality with the JSON value. HTTP vectors: a plain string also requires a JSON string node (Spring jsonPath value(String) never equals a number), except keys listed in expectedTypes as "number" (value(int), compared by numeric value, e.g. nObj "1"). Unit vectors: plain strings compare the text (enum names, counts) without type enforcement.
expectedConventions.<absent>: property missing (Spring jsonPath doesNotExist also accepts explicit null; for unit vectors = Java null, which @JsonInclude(NON_NULL) omits)
expectedConventions.<present>: exists and not null (jsonPath exists / assertThat(x).isNotNull())
expectedConventions.<num:X>: numeric equality via BigDecimal.compareTo (scale-insensitive): new BigDecimal(JSON text) compareTo new BigDecimal(X) == 0; node must exist (AssertUtils.isEqualByComparingTo asserts non-null)
expectedConventions.<rawnum:X>: JSON number whose literal is exactly X (value AND scale; read with USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS)
expectedConventions.<rawnum-scale:N>: JSON number literal with exactly N fractional digits (BigDecimal.scale() == N); with [*] for every element
expectedConventions.<sum-eq:PATH>: numeric value (string or number) equals (compareTo) the exact sum of the numbers at PATH ([*])
expectedConventions.<gt:N>: numeric value > N (compareTo); also implies present
expectedConventions.<gte:N>: numeric value >= N (used for isNotEmpty on lists: length() >= 1)
expectedConventions.<not-regex:R>: (on '$raw') the raw response text must not contain a match of Java regex R
expectedConventions.throws: exception simple class name; isExactlyInstanceOf unless the value is <any:...>
expectedConventions.<none-violated:LIST>: batch: VerificadorInvariantesArredondamento.verificar(response) returns no violation for any listed invariant (see vector notes for the exact rules)
